hooks.command:
f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/SESSION_NOTES.md"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; start=$(grep -nE "^## Session" "$f" | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1); [ -n "$start" ] || exit 0; body=$(tail -n +"$start" "$f"); ot="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/OPEN_THREADS.md"; threads=$([ -f "$ot" ] && cat "$ot"); jq -n --arg c "$body" --arg t "$threads" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Most recent entry from SESSION_NOTES.md (read the full file if you need earlier sessions):

"+$c+(if $t=="" then "" else "

===== OPEN_THREADS.md — cross-session backlog (read at session start, keep it current) =====

"+$t end))}}'
